errors.text: NbMoTaW contains only four elements and therefore violates the stated boundary of five or more metals.
Replacing the starting nanoparticles with a refractory bulk alloy is not an intervention applied to the specified crystalline multielement nanoparticles.
Bulk tensile yield strength does not establish nanoparticle resistance to segregation, diffusion, coalescence, melting, or evaporation under catalytic conditions.
The proposed mechanism—high yield strength from a BCC structure—is unrelated to the target nanoscale mechanism involving active diffusion and surface-energy-driven Au/Cu segregation.
The tensile test neither measures catalytic nanoparticle stability nor provides a clear failure criterion relative to untreated nanoparticles.
No evidence supports catalytic activity, retention of a solid solution, or performance at low noble-metal loading.
